pride_data.title: In cellulo cysteine umpolung for protein structure probing: XL LC-MS/MS Data
pride_data.projectDescription: The dataset contains raw data, peakfiles used for the database searches, as well as search results for the crosslinking LC-MS/MS data
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol:
Overexpression and In-Cellulo Crosslinking of GrxC5: After the in-cellulo crosslinking of overexpressed GrxC5 in E. coli cells, the cells were washed and lysed. The protein was purified using a Ni-column and SDS-PAGE, digested on the gel with trypsin, and each of the samples was analyzed via crosslinking LC-MS/MS.

In-Cellulo Crosslinking with Different Cell Types: Cells were treated with VTT, lysed, and the protein concentration was determined using a BCA assay. The protein digestion was performed according to the SP3 protocol, and the digested samples were analyzed via crosslinking LC–MS/MS
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: xiSearch v1.8.7 was used for the database search, the FDR filtering was performed with xiFDR v2.3.5.
